reply_text:
You first reported the kiosks offline at **10:42 AM on 3 Aug** in #inc-vtg-hartford. Your message said both inbound lanes were showing a white screen after badge scan.

Between that report and kiosk 1 coming back at 11:03, the channel shows only that the guard was **writing trailer numbers on a clipboard**, which is the only guard activity you posted. Mateo later reported six trucks waiting at the east gate, and at 11:03 he wrote that the guard had checked in trailer 8836 and dispatch could see it.

The ticket SUP-5380 update log has an entry at 08:12 that day saying the reboot failed and drivers were queuing. That is earlier than your channel post, so check it if the postmortem needs the first sign of trouble. The entry doesn't say who wrote it or whether anyone reported it.
